about.title: Daughters and Sons of Burundi (FFBN)
about.p1: The Daughters and Sons of Burundi from Nord-Pas-de-Calais (FFBN) is much more than a simple association. It is a family, a mutual aid network and a springboard for the future.
about.p2: Since our creation, we are committed to facilitating integration, promoting academic excellence and valuing Burundian culture around the world.
